Detail: Turbopack raw-copies maplibre-gl-worker.mjs without rewriting its import of maplibre-gl-shared.mjs, so the worker 404s and no .pbf is ever fetched. Vendor both files into public/ so the relative import resolves, then delete the raster branch.
Notes: NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_RASTER=1 is a workaround that contradicts CLAUDE.md line 12 and must not ship. Re-vendor on every maplibre-gl upgrade. Also widen the error filter in map-canvas.tsx - it currently swallows anything not matching /style|sprite|glyphs|tile/i, including Failed to fetch. 2026-08-11 diagnosis only, fix NOT applied. Root cause confirmed in a production build, so it is not dev-only and the earlier React Strict Mode theory is retracted: the worker script itself serves 200, but its first statement imports ./maplibre-gl-shared.mjs, which 404s - Turbopack copies the worker into /_next/static/media/ byte-identical (verified by file hash) without rewriting the specifier, while emitting the sibling content-hashed as maplibre-gl-shared.<hash>.mjs. Module evaluation fails, the Worker error event carries an empty message that MapLibre never surfaces, and 0 .pbf requests are ever made while style.json, tiles.json and sprite all return 200. Evidence: resource timing on localhost:3000 production build, pbf=0. Also landed this session: CARTO silent fallback removed - buildRasterStyle returns null without a key and the caller shows the Basemap unavailable notice rather than substituting a provider; must-not-ship note added at the top of lib/map/style.ts citing CLAUDE.md line 12; basemap style pinned to basic-v2-dark. Two things to undo when the raster branch is deleted: (1) buildRasterStyle() now sets a glyphs endpoint, which exists only so the district label layer has fonts on the raster path - the vector style defines its own glyphs, so remove it with the branch rather than carrying it over. (2) firstSymbolLayerId in lib/map/districts.ts returns undefined in raster mode because that style has no symbol layers, so the beforeId insertion is inert and the district layers simply append on top; once vector rendering is restored, verify the ordering actually works and that basemap place names draw above the district boundaries.
